cutoff.prediction_cutoff_at: must be supplied by the source or an independently recorded historical prediction snapshot
cutoff.source_timestamp: must represent source publication/availability time, not local ingestion time

identity.game: source game_id preferred; deterministic derived identity allowed only when source ID is absent and provenance records the derivation
identity.cross_source_aliases: must be resolved through an explicit registry; never by fuzzy matching without an auditable mapping
